name: COLD ROOM
desc: Premium Walk-In Laboratory Cold Room engineered for high-capacity storage of reagent kits, culture media, and sensitive laboratory products. Features a double-walled modular structure with 200mm high-density PUF insulation and a high-efficiency air-cooled refrigeration system.
principle: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS COLD ROOM is a modular walk-in environmental chamber engineered for precise temperature control from -40°C to 20°C, utilizing high-density PUF insulation and an air-cooled R-404 refrigeration system. It is designed for high-capacity storage of temperature-sensitive reagents, culture media, vaccines, enzymes, and biological samples. In clinical and research laboratories, it supports storage of blood plasma, serological reagents, and microbiological culture media such as agar plates and broths, preventing degradation of heat-labile compounds like antibiotics, vitamins, and enzymes. It is also used for stability testing of pharmaceuticals under ICH guidelines, cold chain validation for vaccines, and storage of volatile organic compounds (VOCs) and strong acids that require low-temperature containment to prevent vapor pressure buildup. The chamber meets ISO 9001 and CE standards for laboratory equipment, ensuring uniform temperature distribution and alarm systems for sample integrity.
sop: Ensure the cold room is connected to a 440V, 3-phase power supply and the main isolator switch is ON.
Check that the door is properly sealed and no frost or ice accumulation is blocking the gasket.
Press the 'SET' button once on the microprocessor-based digital controller.
Use the 'UP' and 'DOWN' arrows to adjust to the required target temperature (e.g., -20°C for reagent storage or 4°C for media).
Press 'SET' again to lock the value and initiate the cooling cycle.
Allow the cold room to stabilize for at least 30 minutes before loading samples; monitor the LED display for temperature and alarm status.
Load samples in an organized manner, leaving space for air circulation; avoid blocking the evaporator fans.
Close the door securely and ensure the anti-condensation door system is engaged.
Record the temperature and time in the logbook; check for any alarm signals (high-visibility LED) indicating deviation.

Safety Warning: Never enter the cold room if the temperature is below -20°C without proper thermal protective gear, and always ensure the emergency internal door release is functional to prevent entrapment.
